method: Reviewed all 19 manual pages against official releases, pinned project documents, release-tag UI strings and relevant implementations. Checked the two technical articles for historical scope. This is a source/content review, not a claim of hardware testing on every platform.

baselines.note: GitHub marks this release as non-prerelease despite the RC tag. The project README still calls RC4 the latest version. Download availability was checked against release assets, not that stale README version sentence.

baselines.checked: Both listings include iPhone, iPad and Apple TV; minimum iOS/iPadOS 13 and tvOS 16.

corrections.finding: Host speaker playback was attributed only to server settings.
corrections.resolution: Included the client request, including the Android option to play audio on the host, and kept client mute separate.

corrections.finding: Generic disconnect/quit language did not identify the current menu labels or configurable quit behavior.
corrections.resolution: Documented Pause streaming, Quit streaming, and the stop-host-app/disconnect-only setting.
corrections.evidence: Android v12.13.0 strings.xml: game_menu_disconnect, game_menu_disconnect_and_quit, title_quit_behavior and quit_behavior_*.

corrections.finding: The latest FEC settings, reconnect requirement and persistent manual bitrate behavior were not covered.
corrections.resolution: Added independent ABR/FEC controls, protection/quality budget implications, next-connection behavior, and restore-recommended-bitrate actions.
corrections.evidence: Android v12.13.0 strings.xml FEC/bitrate descriptions; PC v6.5.0 release notes.

corrections.finding: PyroWave guidance omitted the current Android release limits.
corrections.resolution: Explicitly scoped HDR10+/Dolby Vision dynamic-metadata and frame-generation exclusions to Android v12.13.0.

corrections.finding: The Windows entry only directed users to an installer, omitting the ARM64 portable asset.
corrections.resolution: Distinguished x64 installers from ARM64 portable packages.

corrections.finding: Windows 10 22H2 wording could be read as the minimum requirement for every Sunshine component.
corrections.resolution: Scoped the requirement specifically to ZakoDisplay.

corrections.finding: Advanced-operation proof links pointed to a development snapshot.
corrections.resolution: Verified the same operations in v12.13.0 and linked to the release tag; stated the formal-release baseline separately from screenshot builds.
corrections.evidence: Android v12.13.0 TouchInputHandler.kt, AppView.kt and strings.xml.

corrections.finding: Historical results and plans could be mistaken for current installation or device-support guidance.
corrections.resolution: Preserved dated technical history and linked current HDR/input manuals.

limitations: The screenshot builds are Foundation 2026.1015.51059 / GUI 0.5.8 and Android 12.12.13.beta.6, separately labelled in captions and docs/assets/manual/sources.json. They are not relabelled as the formal-release baseline.
No earliest support version is invented where the official compatibility matrix still marks it unverified.
Platform, codec, HDR, input and hardware-specific capabilities still require validation on the target devices and release combination.
